note: PekkaDex news only. In-game dates are never guessed here: Supercell owns that schedule, and the recurring event countdown on the homepage is a separate, clearly-labelled best-effort reminder.

events.title: A daily pick and a clearer front page
events.body: The homepage now leads with a rotating feature banner, quick links to the tools Chiefs open most, and one archive item chosen by the date. Nothing here is sponsored or promoted.

events.title: Fewer placeholders in the cosmetics archive
events.body: Skin, scenery and equipment cards now point at art that exists in the repository. Where a picture genuinely is not on file, the card keeps its labelled silhouette instead of showing a broken image.

events.title: Attack Planner preview
events.body: A manual planner is on the way: place the defences you can see, then read which of the ranked armies fits the base. It is not live yet, and the teaser says so.

events.title: Clash of Clans announcements
events.body: Balance changes and event dates come from Supercell. PekkaDex links to the official site rather than republishing an announcement as its own.
